description:
Problem: every named gateway client (oracle-ci, oracle-local, oracle-cloud) gets the same models and broker accounts with no per-client limit (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/cli.py gateway-clients), so a leaked local or cloud token can drain the quota CI depends on. Revoking a client (remove its token file, then run gateway) needs a healthy broker with every provider logged in, and rebuilds every client, including oracle-ci, from whatever branch the host checkout is on (_project/scripts/oracle_gateway_host.sh:221-245).

Outcome: revoking one client removes it from clients.json atomically, without the broker and without touching the other clients; clients.json is always generated from origin/develop's policy, never the host checkout's branch; per-client limits apply where omp auth-gateway supports them (gate 1).

Decision gates:
1. Inspect the installed omp auth-gateway client schema (docs, --help or strings; no quota spend) for per-client rate, concurrency or model limits. If supported, cap oracle-local and oracle-cloud below oracle-ci and document the values; if not, record the limitation in docs/internal/oracle-gateway-host.md and in context, and build no proxy. check_clients_file and check_gateway_scope currently require identical models for every client (oracle_gateway_host.sh:173-174,197-198); change both if limits differ per client.
2. Host apply (authorised by owner decision Q13; record it in context): run oracle_gateway_host.sh check (read-only) first; apply a changed clients.json only after showing the diff by client name (no tokens) and confirming a clean gateway reload; stop on any check failure.

Item guardrails: never print a token; oracle-ci keeps its current models; no change to the gateway bind address or the tailnet.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build recorded in that item (SHA-256 fa41b27d434380e99b713e4f9ced0f73eb1fc0c409fdf23a57c119971d24bac5, from https://build.stencil.so/d/omp/20261017-231446-291e055/omp-darwin-arm64), verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp.
